properties.name: The served text keeps the reader's lens out of the design: host, else the agent's own memory, else the person's words, asked at most once
properties.rationale: THE CAUSE (fact:the-served-lens-still-tells-the-agent-to-record-a-readers-background-in-the-design-2026-09-30, recorded in the LIVE design, not in this branch's store): req:a-design-holds-who-contributed-never-a-readers-persona was accepted 2026-09-28 with no capability and no check, so nothing read the served text against it; the sentence had shipped since 945f18f (#353, 2026-08-26); skills.rs:382 was its only copy in the lens, and no test pinned it. Approved by @ajs 2026-09-30: "Also, need to fix: reflow2 still tells agents to write the reader's background into the design". WHY THIS REMOVES THE CAUSE: the requirement now has a capability (cap:the-served-text-applies-the-readers-lens-without-writing-it-into-the-design) and a check (ver:no-served-text-writes-a-readers-persona-into-the-design) that reads every served surface, so the old wording cannot come back, in this sentence or another, without a red build. FOUND WHILE FIXING: the same instruction stood in four more served places the fact did not name (where-am-i, the served instructions, topic, why) and a fifth (detect-and-ask's "Read the reader's recorded description on their Contributor"). MEASURED FAILING FIRST, 2026-09-30, on the unfixed tree (origin/main 01fe82a plus the new test only, commit cb59f05), under the shared build lock: the gate test found 35 served sentences telling an agent to hold a reader's persona in the design (the lens on all three rails in all four states; get_instructions whole and its speak-the-readers-domain section; the where-am-i, topic, why and detect-and-ask skill bodies), 38 once shape 3 ("the reader's recorded ...") was added; the positive empty-case test and the described-case test failed on every rail; the classifier's own net passed. CI on the same commit (run 36788447861) failed the same three tests. All four pass on the fix. NOT DONE HERE: the INVALIDATES edge to fact:the-served-lens-still-tells-the-agent-to-record-a-readers-background-in-the-design-2026-09-30 and its valid_to (its `steps: [add_contributor]` lesson is still served at add_contributor on any server holding it) wait for the store that holds both nodes; req:the-agent-learns-who-it-is-talking-to and req:the-agent-says-which-recorded-reader-it-assumes-and-the-lens-names-them keep their TO BE REVISED notes for @ajs's word.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: skills.rs lens_line: the empty case no longer says "Ask what they do day to day and what they trained in … then record it with `add_contributor`", and the described case no longer says "Recorded backgrounds: … Read the one for whoever you are talking to … If it is somebody else, ask and record it". Both now say the reader's lens comes from the host (flo2 hands over the signed-in person's persona), else the agent's own memory, else the person's own words with one question at most, never written into the design; a contributor is read for attribution and their role. More than one PERSON recorded (not only more than one described) now asks the agent to offer its git-author match and attribute to it. where-am-i's "Who you are talking to" step, the served instructions' "Find out whose domain it is", topic, why and detect-and-ask say the same; add_contributor's `description` parameter is documented as a role, not a reader's persona. Three lens tests follow the new empty-case headline.
